audience: hospitality teams that manage rooms, rates and reservations in WuBook ZaK

useCases.title: Check availability before taking a booking
useCases.text: The AI checks room availability for a stay and reads rate values for the relevant dates. Bookable capacity comes from the availability count, which can differ from the number of listed physical rooms.

useCases.title: Review arrivals and reservation details
useCases.text: The AI lists today’s reservations and opens a selected booking to review its dates, rooms, occupancy, charges and recorded payment.

useCases.title: Change prices or close dates for sale
useCases.text: The AI reads current rate values and updates the daily prices, availability or restrictions you specify. Changes can affect live bookings and connected channels, so confirm the values first.

useCases.title: Check guests in or out
useCases.text: After reviewing a booking, the AI can check its guests in or out when requested. You can apply the action to all guests or select reservation-room guest IDs.
